title: kbmon breaks today's cost down by sprint, session and model
goal: the querylog panel's usage_today also gives the day's dollars by model, by session (its s- label) and by sprint (the sprint of the item a session's work window names, none outside one), and kbmon --status cost prints the top three of each with their dollars and gives them as facts by_model, by_session and by_sprint

run:
import datetime,json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,uuid
H=tempfile.mkdtemp();sp=os.path.join(H,'querylog','spool');os.makedirs(sp)
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z')
def row(sid,model,n):return {'id':uuid.uuid4().hex,'ts':now,'surface':'usage','v':1,'session_id':sid,'prompt_id':uuid.uuid4().hex,'reader':1,
    'usage':{'main':{model:{'requests':1,'in':n,'cw':0,'cw1h':0,'cr':0,'out':n}},'start':0,'steps':[]}}
ids=[]
for m,n in (('claude-opus-5-5',100000),('claude-sonnet-5-5',50000)):
    sid=str(uuid.uuid4());ids.append(sid);open(os.path.join(sp,sid+'.jsonl'),'w').write(json.dumps(row(sid,m,n))+'\n')
e=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=H,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd())
o=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','cost','--json'],capture_output=True,text=True,env=e,timeout=120).stdout
j=json.loads(o);f=j['facts'];print(j['lines'],f)
bm,bs,bp=f.get('by_model') or {},f.get('by_session') or {},f.get('by_sprint') or {}
ok=(set(bm)=={'claude-opus-5-5','claude-sonnet-5-5'} and len(bs)==2 and all(str(x).startswith('s-') for x in bs) and bool(bp)
    and abs(sum(bm.values())-f['usd'])<0.01 and abs(sum(bp.values())-f['usd'])<0.01 and not any(i in o for i in ids)
    and any('by model' in l for l in j['lines']) and any('by sprint' in l for l in j['lines']))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
